title: The Hollow Thorn
author: Petra Nystrom
blurb: Yara Thornbury, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
